# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

Powering Progress

### Optimal nutrition for all animals

Every day, we visit thousands of farms all over the world. De Heus specialists are 'hands on' – they
enjoy working closely with farmers, offering expert advice on nutritional strategies that meet
animals’ physiological needs as well as supporting farm management. Our goal is always the same: to
keep animals healthy and drive optimal production. It’s what we call **Powering Progress**!

## Supporting a diverse customer base

De Heus is a fully fledged supplier of nutritional products, producing compound feed, premixes,
concentrates and feed specialities for livestock and aquaculture customers worldwide.

### How to Apply Silopak Silage Film
* **Individual round bales.** Minimum 6 layers with 50% overlap.
* **Individual square bales.** Minimum 8 layers with 50% overlap.
* **Tubeline round and square bales.** Minimum 8 layers.
* **Storage beyond 12 months.** Apply additional layers to extend film life.
* **Pre-stretch ratio.** Maximum 55%. Over-stretching thins the film and removes the puncture
  reserve.
* **Roll storage.** Keep rolls in original packaging, out of direct sunlight, until they go on the
  wrapper.

## High Tear and Puncture Resistance

Bale wrap fails at the weakest point, not the average one. Silopak silage film stretches around
sharp stems and absorbs impact instead of splitting, so oxygen stays out and the bale stays clean.

[Silopak silage film stretched by hand during a tear and puncture resistance test][Silopak silage
film stretched by hand during a tear and puncture resistance test] Resistance TestSee the film
stretched to its limit

A single puncture from a sharp stalk, a cut corner on a square bale, or a stone picked up by the
baler is enough to let oxygen back into the bale, and once air enters, mould and dry matter loss
follow within days. Silopak film uses multi-layer cast LLDPE with high elastic recovery, so it
stretches around sharp material instead of splitting.

The video shows the same test our production team runs on every batch before it leaves the factory.
The film is pulled well beyond its working stretch and pressed against a hard edge, and it holds.
That is what protects a bale through handling, stacking, transport, and a full season outdoors.

### Why Puncture Resistance Matters in the Field
* **Stalky and coarse crops.** Maize, sorghum, and mature grass carry sharp stems that press against
  the film as the bale settles. Low puncture strength creates pinholes that are invisible on day one
  and obvious as spoilage on day 60.
* **Handling and stacking.** Bale grabs, forks, and two-high stacking put concentrated pressure on
  the wrap. High tear resistance stops a small nick from running into a long tear.

# BENEO – Together we contribute to better nutrition and health

The expectations regarding nutritional choices and functionalities of food have drastically grown
over the last decades.

BENEO is your global partner in catering to the [latest trends and developments in the food and feed
industry][124]. Together, we contribute to better nutrition and health. And with local branches all
over the world, you always have a competent expert to talk to. Just get in touch.

Consumers actively choose foods that contribute to their well-being. Even more, products that match
their individual lifestyles are on [trend][125]. As the demand for convenient and easy to prepare
food continues, the expectations on nutrition also continue to grow. To name just a few, these
include the [reduction of sugar][126] and fat without compromising on taste and texture, increased
dietary fibre intake, plus a need for [healthier weight][127] and [energy management][128].

Farmers, breeders as well as livestock or pet owners on the other hand foster increasingly higher
expectations on the nutritional quality of their feed products. They expect targeted feed, aqua and
pet food that provides their animals with the right amount of nutrients.

# BENEO – Together we contribute to better nutrition and health

The expectations regarding nutritional choices and functionalities of food have drastically grown
over the last decades.

BENEO is your global partner in catering to the [latest trends and developments in the food and feed
industry][124]. Together, we contribute to better nutrition and health. And with local branches all
over the world, you always have a competent expert to talk to. Just get in touch.

Consumers actively choose foods that contribute to their well-being. Even more, products that match
their individual lifestyles are on [trend][125]. As the demand for convenient and easy to prepare
food continues, the expectations on nutrition also continue to grow. To name just a few, these
include the [reduction of sugar][126] and fat without compromising on taste and texture, increased
dietary fibre intake, plus a need for [healthier weight][127] and [energy management][128].

Farmers, breeders as well as livestock or pet owners on the other hand foster increasingly higher
expectations on the nutritional quality of their feed products. They expect targeted feed, aqua and
pet food that provides their animals with the right amount of nutrients.

BENEO’s [ingredients][129] can be applied to a wide variety of food applications: from beverages to
baby food, bakery, confectionery, cereals, soups and sauces. We also supply ingredients for
different kinds of [animal nutrition][130], ranging from cattle feed to cat food.

nutritional value.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**NOURISH**

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Our purpose

# Feeding the Future

Nutreco is a leading animal nutrition company offering solutions that go beyond nutrition – we
provide best-in-class advice and technology to help our customers produce more feed in a sustainable
way to feed the growing population.

## Nutreco's story 

Imagine a baby born in 2025. Digital native, world citizen, modern human. And like all the other 8,3
billion humans on the earth today (2026), an omnivore able to choose a varied diet, with protein an
important daily part. At Nutreco, our business is built around supporting the people who produce
this healthy protein.

[Read our story][56]

## Discover who we are in the video below

### Who we are
* ## Purpose, vision & values
  
  Everything we do as a company is driven by our purpose, vision and values.
  
  [ Read more ][57]
* ## Sustainability
  
  We are working across the value chain to create a more sustainable food system, and a better
  future for our industry and our planet.
  
  [ Read more ][58]
* ## People & careers
  
  We believe in three core elements to future success: strategy execution, innovation, and
  competence of our people. Our values; Trust, Inclusion,  Integrity, Curiosity and Passion are
  supportive of those three core elements. 
  
  [ Read more ][59]

# Feeding the Future

In a world with limited natural resources and a growing population, we want to use our scale and the
power of innovation to lead the change towards more circular and renewable food production methods,
with care and consideration for the people and nature that make them possible.

[Discover what drives us][65]

* [Our approach][66]
* [Our governance][67]
* [Our research][68]

## About Trouw Nutrition

We have a 90-year history of dedication to innovation and deep experience in developing smarter and
more sustainable ways of raising healthy farm animals and companion animals. Our broad portfolio of
feed specialties, feed additives, premixes and nutritional models and services, along with our
ever-increasing expertise in feed, farm and health make us a one-stop-shop with limitless
opportunities to create tailored, integrated solutions suited to each customer’s local situation.
And we are everywhere our customers need us, with a presence in 105 countries. We believe the power
of nutrition and good farm management can transform our industry – and even our planet. So, we are
challenging how the feed-to-food chain works today, to create a brighter future, from planet to
plate.

health. From first-to-market therapies to AI-powered diagnostic platforms, our innovations span the

Our colleagues around the globe are connected through an unwavering commitment to those we serve and

over 100 countries.

### Welcome to Zoetis

As the world’s leading animal health company, Zoetis is driven by a singular purpose: to nurture our
world and humankind by advancing care for animals. 

With a legacy of nearly 75 years, Zoetis continues to pioneer ways to predict, prevent, detect, and
treat animal illness, supporting veterinarians, livestock producers, and pet owners in over 100
countries.  

We integrate deep scientific expertise, data-driven R&D, advanced manufacturing, and commercial
excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics,
biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions.

# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them.

# Performance Driven Nutrition

Performance Driven NutritionPerformance Driven NutritionPerformance Driven Nutrition

Practical feed solutions to deliver performance in your livestock, poultry,  & pets.

Arrow Feeds, manufactured by O’Neal’s Feeders Supply, Inc. in DeRidder, Louisiana, are founded on a
legacy of providing practical, wholesome nutrition to flocks and herds of all sizes — whether they
are at the backyard level for lifestyle farmers or at the commercial level for larger scale
producers. A keen focus on the welfare and performance of each individual animal consuming our feed
guides all facets of our operation from formulation through ingredient selection, processing,
packing, and shipping.
* Produced in DeRidder, Louisiana by a local family founded, employee owned firm approaching its
  seventieth anniversary of operation—***We are not new “out here.”***
* Science based and field proven formulas…. **NO **least cost formulas or hastily adopted unproven
  ingredients or practices—***We know what works “out here.”***
* Made from wholesome grains and food co-products to produce safe, consistently palatable and
  nutritious feed products… **NO** distressed grains or salvage by-products in our feeds—***Our
  ingredients are the best available “out here.”***
* Stored and processed to preserve nutritional integrity and to maintain food safety—***The welfare
  and performance of your livestock and poultry is our focus “out here.”***
* Packed in practical, not glamorous, packages to preserve the feed inside—***The performance inside
  the package is our value “out here.”***
* Arrow Feeds dealer partners and the service team at O’Neal’s Feeders Supply, Inc. in DeRidder will
  always provide friendly, professional, experienced based, and knowledgeable service—***We will
  serve you “out here.”***
* Please contact your nearest Arrow Feeds dealer for more information or visit us at our Farm Supply
  Center in DeRidder, Louisiana where we can serve you in our show room or through our convenient
  drive through window—***WE load the bags “out here.”***

## Welcome to BisProfiles: Your Ultimate Guide to Business Discovery

Are you searching for the perfect local service provider? Looking to discover hidden gems in your
area? Or maybe you need to find a trusted business partner for your next project?

At **BisProfiles**, we’ve been helping businesses and individuals alike by aggregating public and
open data into one of the most comprehensive business directories available. With over 10 years of
experience, we’re dedicated to making information accessible, accurate, and easy to use—so you can
focus on what matters most: finding the right solutions for your needs.

### Why Choose BisProfiles?
* **Comprehensive Directory**: We aggregate data from multiple sources to ensure you have access to
  the most up-to-date and reliable business information available.
* **User-Friendly Platform**: Whether you’re searching by location, service type, or specific
  keywords, our intuitive interface makes it easy to find exactly what you’re looking for.
* **Trusted Sources**: We rely on public and open data.
* **Years of Experience**: With over a decade of expertise, we’ve refined our approach to deliver
  the best possible experience for our users.

### What Can You Find Here?

From local restaurants and retail stores to professional services and industrial suppliers,
BisProfiles is your go-to destination for discovering businesses in any industry or location.
Whether you’re looking for a service provider near you or exploring opportunities across the
country, we’ve got you covered.

# Delivering Excellency in Livestock Fodder

Drupada Mitra Taksaka is a trusted livestock feed distributor in Indonesia, supplying high-quality
feed ingredients such as cassava chips, molasses, palm kernel meal, copra meal, CGF, and industrial
salt to support sustainable livestock nutrition.

[white cement bags stacked in piles]

##### Who Are We?

## Your Strategic Partner in Livestock Nutrition

Drupada Mitra Taksaka is a dedicated distributor of essential feed ingredients. Our extensive
portfolio includes minerals and agricultural by-products sourced with strict quality control to
ensure optimal livestock health and performance.

 

We’re committed to helping our clients grow sustainably through dependable supply chains and
responsive service.

[ Know More About Us ][12]

## Our Product

[Gaplek]

#### Dried Cassava

A reliable carbohydrate source used in livestock feed formulations. Our dried cassava is processed
to ensure low moisture and high nutritional value, ideal for ruminants and poultry feed.

#### Palm Kernel Meal

A high-fiber, protein-rich by-product of palm oil extraction. Palm Kernel Meal is a cost-effective
feed ingredient widely used for cattle, goats, and sheep to support growth and energy needs.

#### Salt

An essential mineral additive in feed rations that promotes digestion, enhances appetite, and
supports overall animal health. We supply industrial-grade salt suitable for livestock and feed
processing.

# Delivering Excellency in Livestock Fodder

Drupada Mitra Taksaka is a trusted livestock feed distributor in Indonesia, supplying high-quality
feed ingredients such as cassava chips, molasses, palm kernel meal, copra meal, CGF, and industrial
salt to support sustainable livestock nutrition.

[white cement bags stacked in piles]

##### Who Are We?

## Your Strategic Partner in Livestock Nutrition

Drupada Mitra Taksaka is a dedicated distributor of essential feed ingredients. Our extensive
portfolio includes minerals and agricultural by-products sourced with strict quality control to
ensure optimal livestock health and performance.

 

We’re committed to helping our clients grow sustainably through dependable supply chains and
responsive service.

[ Know More About Us ][12]

## Our Product

[Gaplek]

#### Dried Cassava

A reliable carbohydrate source used in livestock feed formulations. Our dried cassava is processed
to ensure low moisture and high nutritional value, ideal for ruminants and poultry feed.

#### Palm Kernel Meal

A high-fiber, protein-rich by-product of palm oil extraction. Palm Kernel Meal is a cost-effective
feed ingredient widely used for cattle, goats, and sheep to support growth and energy needs.

#### Salt

An essential mineral additive in feed rations that promotes digestion, enhances appetite, and
supports overall animal health. We supply industrial-grade salt suitable for livestock and feed
processing.

  an air-conditioned cabin and a camera system, ensuring not only maximum comfort but also work

## Our company

EURO BAGGING, founded in 1998, specializes in the production and distribution of silage baggers
and silage bags. The company’s origins date back to 1996, when Petr Jurek was inspired
by the Canadian system of feed storage in bags. Over time, the company expanded its operations
from the Czech and Slovak markets to more than 35 countries worldwide, including regions in Europe,
Africa, Asia, and Australia. In 2004, EURO BAGGING introduced its own line of innovative machines
under the EURO BAGGING brand, and a year later, expanded its portfolio to include mobile grain
crimpers and composting machines. The company holds the ISO 9001:2015 quality certification
and places strong emphasis on modern technologies and the development of machines tailored
to current trends, in order to meet the needs of users in the field of feed storage in silage bags.
* [ More about us ][26]
* ## Machinery Service
  
  Our technicians are ready to provide you with top-quality machine service.
* ## In-house engineering team
  
  Our engineers are constantly working on innovations and development to achieve optimal performance
  of our machinery.
* ## Reliable relationships and close cooperation with our business partners and customers are our
  ## top priority.
  
  **Dipl. Ing. Petr Jurek**
  
  CEO

## Satisfied customers
* ## Lauritz Haar
  
  Stavanger, Norway
  Switch from round bales to silage in bags
  
  I chose EURO BAGGING technology because of its low investment cost for storage and because it
  ensures a consistent fermentation process — unlike round bales, where fermentation differs
  in every single bale. For bag silaging, you don’t need as much machinery as for round bales — just
  a silage bagger and 2–3 silage wagons, which also have a lower ground pressure. At the same time,
  I save time because once the last wagon is processed, I seal the bag with a zip,
  and the fermentation process is already underway — and I’m done. Laboratory test results confirmed
  that it is a very stable product with minimal losses. I’m convinced this technology has a strong
  future in the feed storage segment.
* ## Florian Kern
  
  Schönberg, Germany
  
  Switch from open storage to silage bags
  
  Since 2009, we have been using silage bag storage technology. Before that, we pressed large square
  bales, and grass and corn silage were stored on open ground, which led to significant losses. We
  started looking for a new storage method to minimize losses, so we bought a used silage bagger
  of Italian origin. However, we weren't convinced by the design of that machine — its concept
  and transport were complicated. We needed to move the machine several times a day from one farm
  to another. In our region, there are many small farms, and we often ensile only small amounts
  of feed. Typically, we need to move and set up the machine 3–4 times a day.
  
  The EURO BAGGING EB 310 LG bagger offers a great solution — it doesn't need to be disconnected
  from the tractor. It is easily set into working position just by reversing. The EB 310 LG has high
  capacity and achieves a high compaction rate in the bag.

## Our company

EURO BAGGING, founded in 1998, specializes in the production and distribution of silage baggers
and silage bags. The company’s origins date back to 1996, when Petr Jurek was inspired
by the Canadian system of feed storage in bags. Over time, the company expanded its operations
from the Czech and Slovak markets to more than 35 countries worldwide, including regions in Europe,
Africa, Asia, and Australia. In 2004, EURO BAGGING introduced its own line of innovative machines
under the EURO BAGGING brand, and a year later, expanded its portfolio to include mobile grain
crimpers and composting machines. The company holds the ISO 9001:2015 quality certification
and places strong emphasis on modern technologies and the development of machines tailored
to current trends, in order to meet the needs of users in the field of feed storage in silage bags.

  Our technicians are ready to provide you with top-quality machine service.

  Our engineers are constantly working on innovations and development to achieve optimal performance
  of our machinery.
* ## Reliable relationships and close cooperation with our business partners and customers are our
  ## top priority.
  
  **Dipl. Ing. Petr Jurek**
  
  CEO

## Satisfied customers
* ## Lauritz Haar
  
  Stavanger, Norway
  Switch from round bales to silage in bags
  
  I chose EURO BAGGING technology because of its low investment cost for storage and because it
  ensures a consistent fermentation process — unlike round bales, where fermentation differs
  in every single bale. For bag silaging, you don’t need as much machinery as for round bales — just
  a silage bagger and 2–3 silage wagons, which also have a lower ground pressure. At the same time,
  I save time because once the last wagon is processed, I seal the bag with a zip,
  and the fermentation process is already underway — and I’m done. Laboratory test results confirmed
  that it is a very stable product with minimal losses. I’m convinced this technology has a strong
  future in the feed storage segment.
* ## Florian Kern
  
  Schönberg, Germany
  
  Switch from open storage to silage bags
  
  Since 2009, we have been using silage bag storage technology. Before that, we pressed large square
  bales, and grass and corn silage were stored on open ground, which led to significant losses. We
  started looking for a new storage method to minimize losses, so we bought a used silage bagger
  of Italian origin. However, we weren't convinced by the design of that machine — its concept
  and transport were complicated. We needed to move the machine several times a day from one farm
  to another. In our region, there are many small farms, and we often ensile only small amounts
  of feed. Typically, we need to move and set up the machine 3–4 times a day.
  
  The EURO BAGGING EB 310 LG bagger offers a great solution — it doesn't need to be disconnected
  from the tractor. It is easily set into working position just by reversing. The EB 310 LG has high
  capacity and achieves a high compaction rate in the bag.
* ## NADEC AGRICULTURE
  
  Saudi Arabia
  Corn silage storage
  
  We, NADEC AGRICULTURE, are one of the largest farms in Saudi Arabia, storing over 80,000 tons
  of silage and supplying it to our dairy farms. This storage system appears to be the best solution
  compared to large silage pits. Bag storage requires much lower investment costs and offers
  significantly greater flexibility.
  
  The sealed bags prevent oxygen infiltration. If the bags are properly filled, we can store silage
  for at least two years with dry matter (DM) losses of less than 8%, which is significantly lower
  than with other technologies.
  
  EURO BAGGING is the right partner for us. Not only are they specialists in the field of bagging,
  but they also provide excellent service with high-quality machines. I would like to highlight
  the openness and entrepreneurial spirit of Lukáš Jurek and strongly recommend EURO BAGGING to all
  potential customers.

professionally, as they wish to be treated. Our belief to respect each individual is key to the

consistent.

feed the world.

We value the safety of our employees, customers, and products. We continuously work to do our part
to ensure a safe and high quality food supply for current and future generations.

J&R Distributing, Inc., also known as J&R Feeds, is a South Dakota owned regional livestock feed
manufacturer. Located in Lake Norden, J&R sells swine, beef, dairy, poultry, and sheep feed.
Additionally, we carry pet foods and a full line of specialty feeds for game birds and exotic
animals. J&R Distributing, Inc. specializes in high quality, top-of-the-line nutrition products and
rations. We formulate for our clients on a complete feed basis to a premix basis. We sell complete
feeds, concentrates, base mixes, micro base mixes, and premix. We also handle a complete line of
feed ingredients. No livestock feeding program is complete without the technical assistance that
goes with it. On the nutrition side, we have in-house experts available to assist with ration
balancing and many other needs your livestock operation may require from ventilation to management
of the breeding herd. Our staff, in conjuction with the network of industry livestock experts, can
find an answer to almost any livestock problem. We provide on-site consultations; telephone
consultations; e-mail consultations; tissue/ serum sampling and interpretation; feed processing
management consultations.


With the many challenges in the livestock industry today, producers look to use a wide range of
ingredients for their livestock operation. J&R Distributing can help meet that need by providing
custom formulations to fit every need. We also bid customer formulations. If your livestock
operation is experiencing problems, we pride ourselves on formulations that eliminate problems with
the breeding herd, growth problems, cost problems, or just about any other problem that arises.
Customers can have their feed delivered right to the farm or mill by a professional team of delivery
personnel using up-to-date equipment. Our delivery fleet includes bag trucks, bulk trucks, bag/bulk
combination trucks, hopper bottom, and flatbeds. Customers can also pick up feed, both in bags or
bulk from our warehouse.

 

J&R Distributing also services clients through a dealer network throughout the greater South Dakota
region. J&R feed dealers are people experienced in the feed business who have availability to all
the services J&R Distributing has available. Dealers are an extension of J&R Distributing’s service
commitment to its customers. In addition to feed, J&R Distributing supplies all your animal health
needs, from vaccines to a full line of feed medications. We work closely with top veterinarians to
monitor closely what is new in animal health.

J&R Distributing, Inc., also known as J&R Feeds, is a South Dakota owned regional livestock feed
manufacturer. Located in Lake Norden, J&R sells swine, beef, dairy, poultry, and sheep feed.
Additionally, we carry pet foods and a full line of specialty feeds for game birds and exotic
animals. J&R Distributing, Inc. specializes in high quality, top-of-the-line nutrition products and
rations. We formulate for our clients on a complete feed basis to a premix basis. We sell complete
feeds, concentrates, base mixes, micro base mixes, and premix. We also handle a complete line of
feed ingredients. No livestock feeding program is complete without the technical assistance that
goes with it. On the nutrition side, we have in-house experts available to assist with ration
balancing and many other needs your livestock operation may require from ventilation to management
of the breeding herd. Our staff, in conjuction with the network of industry livestock experts, can
find an answer to almost any livestock problem. We provide on-site consultations; telephone
consultations; e-mail consultations; tissue/ serum sampling and interpretation; feed processing
management consultations.


With the many challenges in the livestock industry today, producers look to use a wide range of
ingredients for their livestock operation. J&R Distributing can help meet that need by providing
custom formulations to fit every need. We also bid customer formulations. If your livestock
operation is experiencing problems, we pride ourselves on formulations that eliminate problems with
the breeding herd, growth problems, cost problems, or just about any other problem that arises.
Customers can have their feed delivered right to the farm or mill by a professional team of delivery
personnel using up-to-date equipment. Our delivery fleet includes bag trucks, bulk trucks, bag/bulk
combination trucks, hopper bottom, and flatbeds. Customers can also pick up feed, both in bags or
bulk from our warehouse.

 

J&R Distributing also services clients through a dealer network throughout the greater South Dakota
region. J&R feed dealers are people experienced in the feed business who have availability to all
the services J&R Distributing has available. Dealers are an extension of J&R Distributing’s service
commitment to its customers. In addition to feed, J&R Distributing supplies all your animal health
needs, from vaccines to a full line of feed medications. We work closely with top veterinarians to
monitor closely what is new in animal health.

## Feeding Our Forage Feed Blends

Whether as a grain complement, fiber supplement or hay replacement, we’ve got you covered. Not sure
how to add Lucerne Farms forage feed into your horse’s feeding schedule? Click the link below to
learn how.

[learn more][39]

# Feed Complement

Horses have complex digestive systems. That’s why it’s so important to give them the right fuel!
Mixing Lucerne Farms horse forage at a 3:1 ratio with grain and other feeds can increase
digestibility and performance so your horse’s digestive process gets off to a running start.

[Learn More][40]

# Fiber Supplement

Fiber supports digestive health in horses by promoting gut motility and reducing the risk of
gastrointestinal issues such as colic and ulcers. Adding 3-6 lbs of Lucerne Farms horse forage into
your feeding program can help your horse get the proper amount of fiber in a form that’s more
beneficial to their physical and mental health.

[Learn More][41]

# Hay Replacement

Sometimes, traditional hay isn’t an option. This could be due to a lack of good quality forage in
your area, or because your horse has dental problems or respiratory sensitivities that make eating
dry, dusty hay difficult. If this is the case for you, Lucerne Farms forage feed offers a natural
alternative. Feeding Lucerne Farms at 2-2.5% of your horse’s body weight can help them meet their
daily forage requirements.

[Learn More][42]

[[Shijiazhuang Meidi Machinery Co., Ltd.]][29] [Shijiazhuang Meidi Machinery Co., Ltd. was
established in 1992. Mr. Wang Lianshan, the founder, began to engage in mechanical production and
manufacturing in 1992. Up to now, it has developed into a professional manufacturer of forage
harvesters integrating technology R&D, production and manufacturing, and sales and service. Since

perfection, win through quality", manufacturing reliable and durable products with a rigorous and
practical working attitude.][30] [More information][31]

[ Meidi factory produce the best silage making machine to process corn silage in China. Meidi
company has became the leader of the domestic self-propelled forage harvester manufacture.][32]

[Meidi self-propelled silage harvester provides high reliability，high productivity，comfortable
operation. Smooth cutting system，feeding system and grain processing system provide high quality
silage product. Floating header and overload protection help the harvester fit for different working
conditions.][33]

[If you want to become dealer of Meidi you may freely contact us！][34]

silage market, Meidi Machinery has launched various specifications of self-propelled forage
harvesters, which can meet the forage needs of different regions in China. In recent years, our
company has carried out research in the fields of hydrostatic drive travel, corn kernel crushers,
electro-hydraulic control systems, and harvesting headers in the development of forage harvesters.
The research results have been verified in practice and recognized by customers, and are currently
at the leading level in the industry.][36] [More information][37]

## Silage Film

Silage film preserves the nutritional value of silage, feed mixes, hay, and maize. Wrapping forage
in an airtight seal lets a farm store feed for months without depending on fresh grass, which keeps
rations consistent through winter, drought, and every gap between cuts.

Silopak silage wrap is made from **premium virgin LLDPE resins** in our own factory in China. Tested
by customers against harsh weather across dozens of export markets, our film has **lasted more than
18 months** in the field.

Every roll carries a **12 month warranty against UV degradation**, a high tack level for a clean
overlap seal, and the tear and puncture resistance needed for stalky crops and repeated bale
handling. OEM and private label production is available.

[Silopak silage film with a 12 month warranty against UV degradation][Silopak silage film with a 12
month warranty against UV degradation]

### High UV Resistance

12 months guarantee against UV degradation, so the film keeps its strength through a full outdoor
season.

[Silage film for individual and tubeline round and square bale wrappers][Silage film for individual
and tubeline round and square bale wrappers]

### Suitable For All Wrappers

Individual round and square bales. Tubeline round and square bales.

[Silopak silage film made from 100 percent virgin LLDPE resin][Silopak silage film made from 100
percent virgin LLDPE resin]

### High Quality Virgin Material

100% virgin LLDPE. No recycled content or filler, the usual cause of brittle film and uneven
thickness.

[Silage film rolls in 250mm, 500mm and 750mm widths at 25 micron][Silage film rolls in 250mm, 500mm
and 750mm widths at 25 micron]

From in-house silage film production to ready stock and fast worldwide shipping, every roll of
Silopak round bale film and silage wrap is made and quality checked at our own factory in China.

## Silage Film

Silage film preserves the nutritional value of silage, feed mixes, hay, and maize. Wrapping forage
in an airtight seal lets a farm store feed for months without depending on fresh grass, which keeps
rations consistent through winter, drought, and every gap between cuts.

Silopak silage wrap is made from **premium virgin LLDPE resins** in our own factory in China. Tested
by customers against harsh weather across dozens of export markets, our film has **lasted more than
18 months** in the field.

Every roll carries a **12 month warranty against UV degradation**, a high tack level for a clean
overlap seal, and the tear and puncture resistance needed for stalky crops and repeated bale
handling. OEM and private label production is available.

[Silopak silage film with a 12 month warranty against UV degradation][Silopak silage film with a 12
month warranty against UV degradation]

### High UV Resistance

12 months guarantee against UV degradation, so the film keeps its strength through a full outdoor
season.

[Silage film for individual and tubeline round and square bale wrappers][Silage film for individual
and tubeline round and square bale wrappers]

### Suitable For All Wrappers

Individual round and square bales. Tubeline round and square bales.

[Silopak silage film made from 100 percent virgin LLDPE resin][Silopak silage film made from 100
percent virgin LLDPE resin]

### High Quality Virgin Material

100% virgin LLDPE. No recycled content or filler, the usual cause of brittle film and uneven
thickness.

[Silage film rolls in 250mm, 500mm and 750mm widths at 25 micron][Silage film rolls in 250mm, 500mm
and 750mm widths at 25 micron]

### Various Sizes

**Thickness:** 25 µm
**Size:** 750mm x 1500m, 500mm x 1800m, 250mm x 1800m

### How to Apply Silopak Silage Film
* **Individual round bales.** Minimum 6 layers with 50% overlap.
* **Individual square bales.** Minimum 8 layers with 50% overlap.
* **Tubeline round and square bales.** Minimum 8 layers.
* **Storage beyond 12 months.** Apply additional layers to extend film life.
* **Pre-stretch ratio.** Maximum 55%. Over-stretching thins the film and removes the puncture
  reserve.
* **Roll storage.** Keep rolls in original packaging, out of direct sunlight, until they go on the
  wrapper.

## High Tear and Puncture Resistance

Bale wrap fails at the weakest point, not the average one. Silopak silage film stretches around
sharp stems and absorbs impact instead of splitting, so oxygen stays out and the bale stays clean.

[Silopak silage film stretched by hand during a tear and puncture resistance test][Silopak silage
film stretched by hand during a tear and puncture resistance test] Resistance TestSee the film
stretched to its limit

A single puncture from a sharp stalk, a cut corner on a square bale, or a stone picked up by the
baler is enough to let oxygen back into the bale, and once air enters, mould and dry matter loss
follow within days. Silopak film uses multi-layer cast LLDPE with high elastic recovery, so it
stretches around sharp material instead of splitting.

The video shows the same test our production team runs on every batch before it leaves the factory.
The film is pulled well beyond its working stretch and pressed against a hard edge, and it holds.
That is what protects a bale through handling, stacking, transport, and a full season outdoors.

* **Stalky and coarse crops.** Maize, sorghum, and mature grass carry sharp stems that press against
  the film as the bale settles. Low puncture strength creates pinholes that are invisible on day one
  and obvious as spoilage on day 60.
* **Handling and stacking.** Bale grabs, forks, and two-high stacking put concentrated pressure on
  the wrap. High tear resistance stops a small nick from running into a long tear.

Beet pulp is the fibrous feedstuff produced by the commercial processing of sugar beets. What
remains after this processing is a fiber-rich, highly digestible feed that is low in starch and
sugar. That nutritional profile is why beet pulp consistently appears in feeding programs for a wide
range of horses. Horse owners use beet pulp to add weight without relying on grain, to stretch a
forage...

# Versa is the World Leader in Silage Bagging and Handling

#### [[Versa Silage Bagging Smarter Icon]][16]  Store Smarter with Silo Bags

Silage bagging is the ideal mobile solution that allows farmers to store their feed whenever and
wherever. Choose 8′, 9′, 10′, 12′ or 14′ bags up to 500ft long.
* Almost 0% dry matter storage loss
* Increases Total Digestible Nutrients (TDN) for better herd health
* Packages silage and byproducts into individual, sealed bags
* Separate higher moisture feed

#### [[Versa Silage Bagging Cost Saving Icon]][17] Save Money with Silo Bags

Silage Bagging is a cost-saving investment – saving feed, money and storage space. Better feed also
increases milk production in dairy cows and weight gain in beef cattle. 
* Up to 20% more feed savings than traditional storage systems
* More tons of quality feed per storage area to maximize space
* Better design allows less space between bags 

#### [[Versa Silage Bagging Green Harvesting Icon]  ][18]Farm Greener with Silo Bags

Unlike bunkers, pits, silos or piles, Silage Bagging is a green harvesting technology that reduces
volatile organic compounds. Many states are tightening the limits on piles and pits.
* Minimizes exposed areas that spoil feed
* Increases packed density to contain fermentation
* Prevents the pollution caused by volatile organic compounds 

> *“Compared to other storage and harvesting solutions, Versa is a superior machine in three ways:
> higher capacity per hour, ease of maintenance and better fuel efficiency.”*
> 
> * – **Todd Helder, custom operator for dairy farms for over 25 years, averages 200,000 tons of
> bagged feed per year.***

West Feeds, Inc. is a family-owned and operated Texas feed manufacturer and distributor
of award-winning, competitively priced animal and livestock feeds.

performance, we carefully formulate all our feed products with premium ingredients and grains.

family.

# Our purpose

# Feeding the Future

Nutreco is a leading animal nutrition company offering solutions that go beyond nutrition – we
provide best-in-class advice and technology to help our customers produce more feed in a sustainable
way to feed the growing population.

## Nutreco's story 

Imagine a baby born in 2025. Digital native, world citizen, modern human. And like all the other 8,3
billion humans on the earth today (2026), an omnivore able to choose a varied diet, with protein an
important daily part. At Nutreco, our business is built around supporting the people who produce
this healthy protein.

[Read our story][56]

## Discover who we are in the video below

### Who we are
* ## Purpose, vision & values
  
  Everything we do as a company is driven by our purpose, vision and values.
  
  [ Read more ][57]
* ## Sustainability
  
  We are working across the value chain to create a more sustainable food system, and a better
  future for our industry and our planet.
  
  [ Read more ][58]
* ## People & careers
  
  We believe in three core elements to future success: strategy execution, innovation, and
  competence of our people. Our values; Trust, Inclusion,  Integrity, Curiosity and Passion are
  supportive of those three core elements. 
  
  [ Read more ][59]

# Feeding the Future

In a world with limited natural resources and a growing population, we want to use our scale and the
power of innovation to lead the change towards more circular and renewable food production methods,
with care and consideration for the people and nature that make them possible.

[Discover what drives us][65]

* [Our approach][66]
* [Our governance][67]
* [Our research][68]

## About Trouw Nutrition

We have a 90-year history of dedication to innovation and deep experience in developing smarter and
more sustainable ways of raising healthy farm animals and companion animals. Our broad portfolio of
feed specialties, feed additives, premixes and nutritional models and services, along with our
ever-increasing expertise in feed, farm and health make us a one-stop-shop with limitless
opportunities to create tailored, integrated solutions suited to each customer’s local situation.
And we are everywhere our customers need us, with a presence in 105 countries. We believe the power
of nutrition and good farm management can transform our industry – and even our planet. So, we are
challenging how the feed-to-food chain works today, to create a brighter future, from planet to
plate.

## Our company

EURO BAGGING, founded in 1998, specializes in the production and distribution of silage baggers
and silage bags. The company’s origins date back to 1996, when Petr Jurek was inspired
by the Canadian system of feed storage in bags. Over time, the company expanded its operations
from the Czech and Slovak markets to more than 35 countries worldwide, including regions in Europe,
Africa, Asia, and Australia. In 2004, EURO BAGGING introduced its own line of innovative machines
under the EURO BAGGING brand, and a year later, expanded its portfolio to include mobile grain
crimpers and composting machines. The company holds the ISO 9001:2015 quality certification
and places strong emphasis on modern technologies and the development of machines tailored
to current trends, in order to meet the needs of users in the field of feed storage in silage bags.
* [ More about us ][26]
* ## Machinery Service
  
  Our technicians are ready to provide you with top-quality machine service.
* ## In-house engineering team
  
  Our engineers are constantly working on innovations and development to achieve optimal performance
  of our machinery.
* ## Reliable relationships and close cooperation with our business partners and customers are our
  ## top priority.
  
  **Dipl. Ing. Petr Jurek**
  
  CEO

## Satisfied customers
* ## Lauritz Haar
  
  Stavanger, Norway
  Switch from round bales to silage in bags
  
  I chose EURO BAGGING technology because of its low investment cost for storage and because it
  ensures a consistent fermentation process — unlike round bales, where fermentation differs
  in every single bale. For bag silaging, you don’t need as much machinery as for round bales — just
  a silage bagger and 2–3 silage wagons, which also have a lower ground pressure. At the same time,
  I save time because once the last wagon is processed, I seal the bag with a zip,
  and the fermentation process is already underway — and I’m done. Laboratory test results confirmed
  that it is a very stable product with minimal losses. I’m convinced this technology has a strong
  future in the feed storage segment.
* ## Florian Kern
  
  Schönberg, Germany
  
  Switch from open storage to silage bags
  
  Since 2009, we have been using silage bag storage technology. Before that, we pressed large square
  bales, and grass and corn silage were stored on open ground, which led to significant losses. We
  started looking for a new storage method to minimize losses, so we bought a used silage bagger
  of Italian origin. However, we weren't convinced by the design of that machine — its concept
  and transport were complicated. We needed to move the machine several times a day from one farm
  to another. In our region, there are many small farms, and we often ensile only small amounts
  of feed. Typically, we need to move and set up the machine 3–4 times a day.
  
  The EURO BAGGING EB 310 LG bagger offers a great solution — it doesn't need to be disconnected
  from the tractor. It is easily set into working position just by reversing. The EB 310 LG has high
  capacity and achieves a high compaction rate in the bag.

a two person operation within 700 square feet of lab space to a staff of over 70 in 30000 square
feet in four U.S. locations.

CVAS provides services for proximate analysis of commercial feeds and ingredients often used for
quality control purposes by feed manufacturing operations. Sellers and users of feed ingredients
utilize our chemistry services to determine quality. Our web based data management software allows
for efficient retrieval and summarization of this information.

Manure Analysis

CVAS is certified by the Minnesota Department of Agriculture for manure testing. With increasing
emphasis on stewardship of resources, including implementation of feed management planning, manure
testing is becoming a routine evaluation for animal production facilities. Our web based data
management system offers tools for efficient administration of manure testing data.

relationships we have formed, both today and those we make into our future.

to ensure a safe and high quality food supply for current and future generations.

J&R Distributing, Inc., also known as J&R Feeds, is a South Dakota owned regional livestock feed
manufacturer. Located in Lake Norden, J&R sells swine, beef, dairy, poultry, and sheep feed.
Additionally, we carry pet foods and a full line of specialty feeds for game birds and exotic
animals. J&R Distributing, Inc. specializes in high quality, top-of-the-line nutrition products and
rations. We formulate for our clients on a complete feed basis to a premix basis. We sell complete
feeds, concentrates, base mixes, micro base mixes, and premix. We also handle a complete line of
feed ingredients. No livestock feeding program is complete without the technical assistance that
goes with it. On the nutrition side, we have in-house experts available to assist with ration
balancing and many other needs your livestock operation may require from ventilation to management
of the breeding herd. Our staff, in conjuction with the network of industry livestock experts, can
find an answer to almost any livestock problem. We provide on-site consultations; telephone
consultations; e-mail consultations; tissue/ serum sampling and interpretation; feed processing
management consultations.


With the many challenges in the livestock industry today, producers look to use a wide range of
ingredients for their livestock operation. J&R Distributing can help meet that need by providing
custom formulations to fit every need. We also bid customer formulations. If your livestock
operation is experiencing problems, we pride ourselves on formulations that eliminate problems with
the breeding herd, growth problems, cost problems, or just about any other problem that arises.
Customers can have their feed delivered right to the farm or mill by a professional team of delivery
personnel using up-to-date equipment. Our delivery fleet includes bag trucks, bulk trucks, bag/bulk
combination trucks, hopper bottom, and flatbeds. Customers can also pick up feed, both in bags or
bulk from our warehouse.

 

J&R Distributing also services clients through a dealer network throughout the greater South Dakota
region. J&R feed dealers are people experienced in the feed business who have availability to all
the services J&R Distributing has available. Dealers are an extension of J&R Distributing’s service
commitment to its customers. In addition to feed, J&R Distributing supplies all your animal health
needs, from vaccines to a full line of feed medications. We work closely with top veterinarians to
monitor closely what is new in animal health.

## Feeding Our Forage Feed Blends

Whether as a grain complement, fiber supplement or hay replacement, we’ve got you covered. Not sure
how to add Lucerne Farms forage feed into your horse’s feeding schedule? Click the link below to
learn how.

[learn more][39]

# Feed Complement

Horses have complex digestive systems. That’s why it’s so important to give them the right fuel!
Mixing Lucerne Farms horse forage at a 3:1 ratio with grain and other feeds can increase
digestibility and performance so your horse’s digestive process gets off to a running start.

[Learn More][40]

# Fiber Supplement

Fiber supports digestive health in horses by promoting gut motility and reducing the risk of
gastrointestinal issues such as colic and ulcers. Adding 3-6 lbs of Lucerne Farms horse forage into
your feeding program can help your horse get the proper amount of fiber in a form that’s more
beneficial to their physical and mental health.

[Learn More][41]

# Hay Replacement

Sometimes, traditional hay isn’t an option. This could be due to a lack of good quality forage in
your area, or because your horse has dental problems or respiratory sensitivities that make eating
dry, dusty hay difficult. If this is the case for you, Lucerne Farms forage feed offers a natural
alternative. Feeding Lucerne Farms at 2-2.5% of your horse’s body weight can help them meet their
daily forage requirements.

[Learn More][42]

## Uw dieren centraal

Een betere diergezondheid, gezonde groei en meer rendement. Het begint bij slim voeren. Met
voerschema’s die zijn afgestemd op de individuele behoeften van uw dieren. En exact de juiste
dosering in verse, regelmatige porties. Dát maken we mogelijk met onze toekomstgerichte
voersystemen.

[ Meer over SIEPLO ][45]

### Grote arbeidsbesparing

Met onze hydraulische, geautomatiseerde of gerobotiseerde voersystemen is voeren makkelijker en
houdt u meer tijd over voor de controle van uw dieren.

### Meer inzicht

Door de nauwkeurige registratie van voerdata herkent u gezondheidsproblemen eerder en kunt u de
voersamenstelling continu optimaliseren.

### Hoge voeropname

Onze verticale mengsystemen, verfijnde weegmethodiek en slimme doseeroplossingen zorgen ervoor dat u
de voersamenstelling tot in detail kunt controleren. Zo werkt u elke dag aan een hogere voeropname.

### Lange levensduur

De keuze voor de beste, duurzame materialen en de robuuste constructie van onze voersystemen, zorgen
voor lage onderhoudskosten en een lange levensduur.

# Versa is the World Leader in Silage Bagging and Handling

#### [[Versa Silage Bagging Smarter Icon]][16]  Store Smarter with Silo Bags

Silage bagging is the ideal mobile solution that allows farmers to store their feed whenever and
wherever. Choose 8′, 9′, 10′, 12′ or 14′ bags up to 500ft long.
* Almost 0% dry matter storage loss
* Increases Total Digestible Nutrients (TDN) for better herd health
* Packages silage and byproducts into individual, sealed bags
* Separate higher moisture feed

#### [[Versa Silage Bagging Cost Saving Icon]][17] Save Money with Silo Bags

Silage Bagging is a cost-saving investment – saving feed, money and storage space. Better feed also
increases milk production in dairy cows and weight gain in beef cattle. 
* Up to 20% more feed savings than traditional storage systems
* More tons of quality feed per storage area to maximize space
* Better design allows less space between bags 

#### [[Versa Silage Bagging Green Harvesting Icon]  ][18]Farm Greener with Silo Bags

Unlike bunkers, pits, silos or piles, Silage Bagging is a green harvesting technology that reduces
volatile organic compounds. Many states are tightening the limits on piles and pits.
* Minimizes exposed areas that spoil feed
* Increases packed density to contain fermentation
* Prevents the pollution caused by volatile organic compounds 

> *“Compared to other storage and harvesting solutions, Versa is a superior machine in three ways:
> higher capacity per hour, ease of maintenance and better fuel efficiency.”*
> 
> * – **Todd Helder, custom operator for dairy farms for over 25 years, averages 200,000 tons of
> bagged feed per year.***
